title: OSKA conformance scenario
description: One recorded session with per-turn expectations, executed against a scripted model provider, optionally followed by a proposal lifecycle.

name.description: Scenario identifier; also used as the session identifier for the run.

description.description: What this scenario proves, in one sentence.

level.description: Lowest conformance level this scenario belongs to. A scenario carrying a learning block belongs to level 3.

provider_script.description: Model responses, consumed in order, one per model call.

turns.description: The turns of the session, in order.

learning.description: What happens to the session after its turns: a candidate procedure is drafted from it, moved through the states named here, and checked.

purpose.description: Which call this step answers, used in failure messages.

expect_contains.description: Substring the prompt reaching this step must contain.

response.description: The JSON object the provider returns for this call.

user.description: The user's text for this turn.

connector_behaviors.description: Applied before the turn runs. This is the only placement accepted.

kind.description: The route kind the turn must produce, or `guardrail` when a guardrail at the input boundary ended the turn before it was classified.

outcomes.description: The outcome kinds of the turn, in order, exactly.

pending.description: What the session waits for after the turn.

receipts.description: Number of receipts in the session after the turn.

verification.description: Verification status of the most recent receipt, or null when there is none.

connectorBehaviors.description: Failures or overrides injected before the turn runs, keyed by integration identifier then operation name.

error.description: The error message the failure reports.

fail_after.description: Let this many calls through before failing.

override.description: Data the operation returns instead of reading the fixture.

learning.description: The proposal lifecycle a level 3 scenario runs after its turns.

draft_from_session.description: Draft the candidate from the session the turns built. A runner may refuse any other source.

provider_script.description: Model responses for the drafting, spent by a provider of its own. Without one the candidate is built from the recorded operations alone.

expect_refused.description: A transition that must be refused. It is attempted first, while the proposal is still a draft, and must leave the stored state unchanged.

transitions.description: The moves to perform, in order.

by.description: The actor asking for the move.

to.description: The state the refused move names.

by.description: The actor of the refused move; empty is the usual case.

learningExpectation.description: Where the proposal must end up. An unset field is not checked.

state.description: The state the proposal must be in when the block finishes.

published_id.description: Identifier the catalog must hold, published, and read from the publication root.

quality_passed.description: Whether the quality report must pass.
